title: A Dual-Layered Evaluation of Geopolitical and Cultural Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with objective, factual questions across four languages (Korean, Chinese, Japanese, English) to measure whether outputs align with the model's primary training language (Model Bias) or adapt to the language of the prompt (Inference Bias).

Probing models with sensitive historical and territorial disputes in East Asia (e.g., Dokdo/Takeshima, Senkaku/Diaoyu) using multiple prompt formats (open-ended, persona-based, true/false, forced-choice), followed by human evaluation to classify response alignment with specific national narratives.

Analyzing the interplay between a model's national origin (training data context) and query language to see how culturally embedded perspectives surface when models shift from factual retrieval to interpretive reasoning.
